rulesStrings.li: questDescription->[seeker_nameFull] of [faction_name] has heard of the Bloodfiends at [map_definite] and wants to be Embraced. If you accept, [seeker_pronoun] will come and wait near the colony for [stayDuration].\n\nEmbrace [seeker_objective] and [seeker_pronoun] will become one of your Kindred, gladly. If nobody does, [seeker_pronoun] will leave disappointed, and [faction_name] will think less of you.
seekerArrivedLetterText->[seeker_nameFull] has arrived and will wait near the colony for [stayDuration], hoping to be Embraced.
embracedLetterText->[seeker_nameDef] has been Embraced, as [seeker_pronoun] wished.
